notes: For test_media/cctv_walk.mp4 (1280x720 street CCTV, see README 'Flow'). Zones and the line are at head height: heads of people on this pavement pass y=200-300 while they are fully in view (a line at y=360 was only reached as people left the frame). The line reaches the shop front (x=1080) because people walk close to it; stopping at x=1000 missed them. The line is drawn left to right, so its first direction (forward) is moving down the image, towards the camera.
